notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
number is the printed card number (n/10). The extracted file order is not the printed order: cards are listed by printed number.
orientation: 'inverted' = printed upside down on the card (secrets, R-15.82, and some assets).

variants: a section without reputation subsections has a single variant with condition null. 'flavor' is the italic text; 'text' is the rules text. Several printed paragraphs are one string separated by '\n'.
A variant may carry its own 'secret' and 'orientation' when the secret box sits under a reputation condition.
Die icons: solid starburst = {HIT}, outlined spiky starburst = {CRIT}, eye = {FOCUS}.
Embedded assets keep the printed trait in 'traits' (ILLEGAL -> illegal).
Navpoint encounter cards have two sections: 'No Patrol' and 'Patrol' (the state of the navpoint). Both headers print a navigation icon, not transcribed.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Hutt reputation:
variants.flavor: One of your Hutt contacts gave you coordinates to a black market space station in this area.
variants.text: Choose a market deck and reveal the top 3 cards of it. You may buy 1 of these cards. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: They’ve found you.
variants.text: Move the Hutt patrol to your space and encounter it.

variants.flavor: You share information with the Hutts about the location of a wanted fugitive.
variants.text: Action: Discard this card to move the Hutt patrol directly to the space of your choice.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
variants.flavor: The smuggler grins at you. “You think you’re the better pilot? Why don’t you prove it in that asteroid field?”
variants.text: You may test Piloting. If you pass, gain {CREDITS}3,000. If you fail, your ship suffers 3 damage.

variants.flavor: There appears to be a bounty hunter on your tail.
variants.text: Test Piloting. If you fail, fight a ship combat against a bounty hunter ({SHIP_COMBAT} 4). If you win, prevent 2 damage from this combat.

variants.flavor: “We’ve heard rumors of pirate activity in this system. Do you have any leads?”
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}1,000 to move a patrol in your space directly to any space.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
variants.flavor: Imperial data about this part of space suggest there should be a shortcut up ahead.
variants.text: Move up to 2 spaces.

variants.flavor: The Empire is everywhere, and they are hunting you.
variants.text: Move the Imperial patrol directly to any space that is adjacent to your space.

variants.flavor: The last thing you need is unwanted attention.
variants.text: You may test Stealth. If you pass, you may take an additional turn. If you fail, lose 1 reputation with a patrol in your space.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
variants.flavor: You experience engine trouble and send out a distress signal.
variants.text: Move the Rebel patrol directly to your space. Then recover all damage from your ship.

variants.flavor: You don’t notice the space mines until you’re almost on top of them. Evasive maneuvers!
variants.text: Test Piloting. If you fail, your ship suffers 3 damage.

variants.flavor: “To anyone that can hear us, we’ve suffered engine failure and need assistance.”
variants.text: Test Tech. If you pass, gain 1 reputation with a patrol in your space; if you already had {REP_POS} reputation with this faction, you may spend {CREDITS}10,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.flavor: You find a derelict Hutt transport. The crew is missing, but they had a big haul of resources.
variants.text: You may gain the cargo below. If you do, lose 1 Hutt reputation.

variants.flavor: The patrol is on the lookout for a fugitive.
variants.text: You may choose a player who has {REP_NEG} reputation with a patrol in your space. Move that patrol directly to that player’s space, and they must encounter that patrol.

asset.name: Stolen Cargo
text: To deliver, roll a die. On a {HIT}, deliver this. Otherwise, resolve card #1.

variants.flavor: In deep space, you intercept a transmission intended for someone else.
variants.text: Action: Discard this card and choose another player in your space. That player decides either to have no effect or to have each of you gain 1 fame.

variants.flavor: You dock with the ship and offer information as a show of good faith.
variants.text: Test Knowledge. If you pass, gain 1 reputation with a patrol in your space; if you already had {REP_POS} reputation with that faction, reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_GEAR} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed mod for free. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: A mining operation recognizes your loyalty to Crimson Dawn and offers you some Clouzon-36 fuel.
variants.text: Move up to 5 spaces.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
variants.flavor: You receive a distress call from a ship trapped inside of a giant space slug.
variants.text: You may test Tech. If you pass, gain {CREDITS}2,000 and 1 Syndicate reputation. If you fail, your ship suffers 3 damage.

variants.flavor: The patrol asks that you cut your engines, and you consider ignoring their request.
variants.text: You may test Piloting. If you pass, you may take an additional turn. If you fail, encounter a patrol in your space.

variants.flavor: You catch a distress signal from a civilian ship.
variants.text: Test Tech. If you pass, and you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame. If you pass and you are the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
variants.flavor: You experience engine trouble and send out a distress signal. Nobody responds.
variants.text: Test Tech. If you fail, your ship suffers 2 damage.

variants.flavor: They’re recruiting informants in this sector of space.
variants.text: Test Influence. If you pass, gain 1 reputation with a patrol in your space; if you already had {REP_POS} reputation with that faction, gain {CREDITS}4,000.

variants.flavor: The Empire offers you the funds needed to work against the Rebellion.
variants.text: You may lose up to 2 Rebel reputation. Then, if you have {REP_NEG} Rebel reputation, gain {CREDITS}5,000.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
variants.flavor: Here, in the middle of nowhere, you find a makeshift Imperial checkpoint. Better get your bribes ready.
variants.text: Test Piloting. If you fail, lose {CREDITS}2,000 unless you discard 1 of your cargo.

variants.flavor: You make a deal with the ship’s captain.
variants.text: Action: Discard this card to move any patrol directly to your space. Then, choose a player in your space that has {REP_NEG} reputation with that patrol to encounter it.

variants.flavor: Floating through space, you devise a plan to claim someone else’s deeds as your own.
variants.text: Action: Discard this card and choose a player in your space that has more fame than you. You gain 1 fame and that player loses 1 fame. You then lose 1 reputation of that player’s choice.

variants.flavor: The ship’s captain demands you pay a tariff for traveling through this sector. You could try to scare them off by faking a reactor leak.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain 1 reputation with a patrol in your space. Then, if you have {REP_NEG} reputation with a patrol in your space, test Tech. If you fail, your ship suffers 2 damage.
